component.name: EShot
component.summary: Screenshot, annotation, OCR, upload, GIF and video capture tool

description.p: EShot is a native desktop screenshot workflow tool for Windows and Linux. It captures regions, annotates images, copies or saves output, uploads screenshots, extracts text with OCR, pins references, and records GIF or MP4 captures.
On Linux, EShot integrates with KDE Plasma 6 and GNOME Wayland through desktop portals for screenshots, global shortcuts, notifications, and PipeWire screen recording.
Makes folder opening an explicit, optional notification action and restores capture shortcuts after selecting an entire screen on KDE Wayland.
Fixes capture-selection frame alignment and prevents the frame from showing through resize handles on scaled displays.
Adds single-edge capture selection resizing with compact midpoint handles and keeps the selection border visually consistent at fractional display scales.
Stabilizes simultaneous desktop and microphone audio recording on PipeWire and EasyEffects setups, while retaining compatibility with the GStreamer version used by supported Linux builds.
Fixes the capture guidance panel leaving trails when region selection starts and restores a compact, consistently sized application control window.

Polishes the compact capture panels, improves selection responsiveness and memory use, makes recording finalization non-blocking, adds optional settings-window size memory, and prevents package-managed AppImages from creating a second user installation.

Adds a consistent control window when EShot is launched normally, secure operating-system storage for OAuth tokens, and optional silent updates for self-managed installations that are at least two stable releases behind.
Improves text editing and resizing, adds OCR translation handoff, restores annotation shortcuts, and expands trayless GNOME support with reliable recording completion.
Adds free text and shape rotation, a focused recording setup panel with microphone selection, and recording-border lock and tray cancellation controls.
Eliminates subtle capture preview flickering while moving regions on fractionally scaled displays.
Keeps the physical selection size stable while moving a capture region on fractionally scaled displays.
Fixes unfinished annotations carrying into the next capture and reports the correct physical selection resolution on scaled displays.

Improves settings localization and layout, adds resilient visual search uploads, repairs TmpFiles links, removes the unavailable Litterbox provider, restores Yandex Disk, and improves Windows dependency caching.
Restores capture shortcuts after modal dialogs on Linux, fixes the XWayland color picker freeze, and makes the vertical Quick Settings tab responsive to longer translations.

Improves KDE Plasma and GNOME capture reliability, restores capture shortcuts after dialogs, fixes the annotation color picker and theme startup, and improves first-run GNOME shortcut and tray integration.
Adds a dedicated animated window capture mode on Windows, improves recording defaults and controls, and fixes Windows tray startup, audio device, and packaged SVG icon issues.
Fixes false missing AAC encoder errors on Linux when GStreamer plugin discovery takes longer during its first run.

Improves draggable capture-safe recording controls on Windows and Linux, fixes KDE Plasma full-screen recording geometry, adds experimental GNOME Wayland integration, and expands Linux portal and package-manager compatibility.

Adds automatic OCR language selection, a configurable capture help panel, dynamic settings tab sizing, immediate update state sharing, safer KDE Wayland capture authorization, and allows unrelated settings to save when an unchanged hotkey is unavailable.
Redesigns the GIF and video recording controls, adds GIF pause and resume, fixes clickable KDE Plasma notifications, and prevents translation tests from changing the saved application language.
Adds DNF dependency setup for Fedora and Nobara, localizes setup errors, makes the tray respond to a normal click, and falls back to the desktop shortcut portal when KDE cannot claim PrintScreen.
Rebuilds the Linux AppImage for baseline x86-64 CPUs and older glibc versions instead of inheriting CachyOS build-host requirements.
Reduces KDE Plasma 6 capture latency by preparing direct KWin screenshot access for integrated AppImages while preserving the cursor-free Spectacle fallback.
Polishes capture annotations, improves KDE Plasma 6 integration, fixes cursor-free Wayland screenshots and AppImage autostart, and restores reliable text entry on KDE/XWayland.
Adds the complete Linux and KDE Plasma 6 port, AppImage and native packages, Wayland capture and recording, Linux desktop integration, and selectable Google Lens or Yandex visual search.
Windows maintenance release preceding the experimental Linux port.
